newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Materiels raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Materiels raised to buy.

text.p: - Robertson Stephens & Co research analyst Sue Billat said shr raised her rating on Applied Materials Inc to buy from long-term attractive.
- Billat cited AMAT's first quarter earnings of $0.48 a share and orders for the quarter, which exceeded expectations and came in at $905 million, up from $638 million in the prior quarter.
- Billat raised her earnings estimates to $2.20 a share from $2.00 for fiscal 1997, and to $3.25 from $3.00 for fiscal 1998.
